# Ahmad Automatic Washing Repair

> Home repair service in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia for automatic washing machines, dishwashers and dryers. Technicians visit the customer's home, diagnose the fault and repair the appliance on site where possible. Website in English and Arabic.

## Key facts
- Business: Ahmad Automatic Washing Repair (Arabic: أحمد لإصلاح الغسالات الأوتوماتيك)
- Services: automatic washing machine repair, dishwasher repair, dryer repair
- Brands: LG, Samsung, Daewoo, Bosch, Toshiba, Hitachi, Midea, Haier, Whirlpool, Maytag, Panasonic, Westinghouse, Ariston and others
- Service area: Riyadh (north, east, west and south)
- Address: Al Quds District, Muhammad bin Faisal bin Turki Street, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
- Phone and WhatsApp: +966 55 939 1603
- Hours: open 24 hours, 7 days a week
- Not repaired: refrigerators, air conditioners, ovens, TVs
- Independent repair service, not affiliated with any appliance manufacturer
- Website: https://www.ahmadwashingrepairriyadh.com/en and https://www.ahmadwashingrepairriyadh.com/ar
- Sitemap: https://www.ahmadwashingrepairriyadh.com/sitemap.xml
